title: Trek: A self-hosted travel/trip planner with real-time collaboration, interactive maps, PWA support

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Group trip planning always collapses into a Google sheet. Nobody updates and a group chat full of forwarded confirmation emails. Trek is a self-hosted travel planner built specifically for that problem. You get a beautiful drag and drop itinerary, interactive maps, and real-time collaboration. It even tracks your flights, budgets, and packing lists. The best part, your friends can install it directly to their phones without the app
